'''Securi-vaults''' were a type of secured location. [[Doctor/Legends|Doctor]] [[Nashiak Llalik]] maintained a securi-vault at their [[Nashiak Llalik's mansion|manor]] on [[Plavin 6]], which stored the only prototype of the [[Sunder 9]] armor.<ref name="GFT">''[[Gundark's Fantastic Technology: Personal Gear]]''</ref>
